The donor demonstrates a relevant mechanism rather than mere feature similarity: reverse opener selection uses structured link/image delimiter records, bracket nesting depth, and an active flag. On a successful ordinary inner link, mark enclosing ordinary-link openers ineligible; do not suppress an enclosing ordinary link merely because an inner parse failed, and do not treat a successfully parsed image as a nested ordinary link. Preserve source-order emission by buffering committed results, with the existing source origins, destination parser, masks, paragraph boundaries, and public iterators unchanged.
